title: REQ · App loads the round from the Go API with explained errors, empty state and retry
summary: App maps API failures to a cause, treats 404 as empty and reloads on retry
description: Context: App.tsx (L14-L28) calls getCurrentRound once and stores e.message. Desired behavior: a describeRoundError helper gives the cause (HTTP status, server detail, or network failure), a 404 yields the empty state, and a retry callback reloads and passes onRetry to HeaderOverlay. Backend CurrentRound returns 404 when no round exists (backend/internal/world/handler.go). Why: distinct states and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Given getCurrentRound rejects ApiError 500, when App renders, then the alert explains 'Round service returned 500'
Given it rejects ApiError 404, then 'No active round' is shown with no alert
Given a failure then Retry click with success, then the round id and status appear
Given a network TypeError, then the alert says the server could not be reached
technical_constraints: No mock data in production code
